selection: Ordered human metadata-only selection of three independent public Java library repositories. This is a bit/math utility stratum, not random general-Java sampling. No replacement or success-conditioned quota.

repositories.reason: Java low-level utility library; distinct application domain. Redirect resolved through GitHub metadata before selection.
Java networking library; independent repository with production utility code.
Java game-development library; different application domain with mathematics utilities.

file_rule.order: repository pool order, then UTF-8 path order

method_rule: Every explicitly public static method with exactly one primitive int/long parameter and boolean/int/long return, including nested classes and unsupported or side-effecting bodies. Inventory independently of QKF; preserve exact source spans and all lexical ambiguities.

exposure.baseline_text_provenance_scan: No repository URL matches for these three repositories or Agrona's former owner in baseline research/examples/third_party/docs text files; this does not prove absence of historical or model-training exposure.
exposure.private_or_training_exposure: unknown; no claim of training-data blindness
exposure.post_acquisition_review: Record exact raw and normalized clones against retained development sources and all known exposure before the corpus gate.
